Netflix Documentary Features Olympic Breakdancing

A Netflix documentary titled 'Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly' focuses on Olympic breakdancing. The film explores the journey of breakdancing's inclusion in the Olympics and its portrayal in popular culture. Coverage highlights the documentary's perspective on the sport's evolution and its presence on the streaming platform.
